Am I even mentioned in AI?

That question kept coming.

So three friends built an answer to it.

You can be the best company in the region and have existed for a hundred and fifty years. If AI does not mention you when someone asks, the next customer does not know you are there.

It started with customers asking the same thing

Damian has run IQ Script, an agency for websites and findability, for eight years. In 2025 customers kept asking him the same question.

The honest answer was that nobody knew. So he set out to find out. He did a lot of research and tested what does and does not work to end up in AI answers. Much more turned out to be possible than he expected.

Am I even mentioned when someone asks ChatGPT?
What customers kept asking us in 2025

Then two carpenters came in one week

The first time it really worked was at our own company. IQ Script published a few articles about carpenters.

Five to six weeks later, two requests came in within one week. Both from a carpenter, both from the same region. In eight years that had never just happened. That was when we knew it was no coincidence.

Why it did not become an agency

We saw agencies trying this too. Often for a lot of money, with hours, separate campaigns and a dashboard you have to dig through yourself. We wanted it differently.

What NXEO is not

  • An SEO agency
  • A tool you have to operate yourself
  • An advertiser
  • Hours, campaigns and separate invoices
  • Dashboards to get lost in

What NXEO is

  • One fixed amount per month
  • We do the work, you approve
  • Content on your own website
  • One report you read in five minutes
  • Everything we make stays yours

It also works for who you do not want to reach

Ferry of De Scooter Dokter comes by with his van and works on your scooter at your door. He got many requests from regions he does not serve at all. That was a big frustration for him.

Now he is contacted more often from his own region and less from outside it. Findability works both ways: when it is clear where you do not work, you are no longer mentioned there either.

For companies ready to grow

NXEO is made for B2B companies of 5 to 50 people that win customers on trust and findability. You know your customers use ChatGPT, but you have no idea whether you are mentioned yourself.
